$comment: Pack Rat shard rules file schema v1. Draft-07 style, restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mjs supports. A rules file carries everything that is shard-specific rather than OSI-standard: property caps, the Resisting Spells resist-bonus formula, race-specific cap overrides, tag-penalty units, the rarity ladder (name + colour, in ascending order), the gargoyle race-lock policy and the free-skill list shown on character cards. app/rules.mjs validates every builtin and user rules file against this schema before it reaches setRules().
